source.title: City of Billings Bid 1421 - Laboratory Information Management System

rfp_basis.S3_FIELD: Section 3: web UI plus integrated field application; sample collection, field entry, electronic chain of custody, and offline operation.
rfp_basis.S3_LIFECYCLE: Section 3: complete sample lifecycle traceability, custody events, and disposition activities.
rfp_basis.S3_ANALYST: Section 3: track analyst demonstration of capability, training, and certification status for each method.
rfp_basis.S3_STORAGE: Section 3: centralized secure storage with redundancy and disaster recovery.
rfp_basis.S3_RBAC: Section 3: role-based access control for data integrity and accountability.
rfp_basis.S3_AUDIT: Section 3: real-time audit trails and logs for data changes and activity history.
rfp_basis.S3_INSTRUMENT: Section 3: automated laboratory-instrument acquisition and processing; Attachment F names instruments.
rfp_basis.S3_QC: Section 3: tools for documenting and charting QC and QA processes.
rfp_basis.S3_COA: Section 3: upload and store certificates of analysis for chemical inventory.
rfp_basis.S3_REPORTS: Section 3: customizable regulatory, client, and internal report templates.
rfp_basis.S3_SUPPORT: Section 3: training materials, help resources, dedicated technical support, updates, and issue resolution.
rfp_basis.S7_SECURITY: Section 7: security aligned to NIST CSF, current NIST SP 800-53, FIPS 199 categorization, independent evidence, and annual NIST or FedRAMP assessment reports.
rfp_basis.AF_METHODS: Attachment F: 37 listed analyte/method rows, including EPA, Standard Methods, HACH, calculated, and two blank-method entries.
rfp_basis.AF_INSTRUMENTS: Attachment F: five pH meters, three balances, PerkinElmer Furnace AA, Metrohm Ion Chromatograph, Sievers TOC Analyzer, and Seal Discrete Analyzer.
rfp_basis.AF_REPORTS: Attachment F: CMDP drinking-water reporting, netDMR reporting, and operations dashboards or external BI links.
rfp_basis.WORK_ORDER_BOUNDARY: Internal Billings work order: synthetic data only and the system must not release regulatory results.

notes: All people, roles, samples, devices, results, limits, times, and payloads are synthetic fixtures.
The City must supply the authoritative role matrix, QC limits, method versions, report layouts, retention rules, instrument protocols, and security categorization.
Instrument names in cases are mock source labels derived from Attachment F; they are not compatibility claims.
A complete draft remains a draft until authorized City laboratory personnel approve and perform any regulatory release outside this test system.
